'''Talonbane Cobra''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and assassin who flew with the [[Navy/Legends|space forces]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AtA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he flew a [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] and had earned the title of [[Ace/Legends|ace]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], Cobra was killed in the [[Lurid Aurora Nebula]] by [[Laetin A'shera]]'s forces working for the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] organization.<ref name="SWG:AtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempBlackSunSpaceComm.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Talonbane Cobra]]
Talonbane Cobra was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Talonbane Cobra was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:AtA" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
